lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg12Cu10Co4 (reduced formula Mg6Cu5Co2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives all Co, Cu, and Mg centers 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances from about 2.48 to 2.79 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Co–Cu and Cu–Cu 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
